diagnostic_sources.pan-current.onda:
import std/osc
import std/filter
import std/env
import std/levels
import std/random

const NumVoices = 8

proc Voice:
  params:
    decay_s = 0.35
    amp = 1.0

  init:
    freq = 220.0
    cutoff = 1200.0
    osc = std::osc::Saw(freq = freq)
    lpf = std::filter::OnePole(cutoff = cutoff)
    env = std::env::DecayEnv(decay_s = decay_s)

  event bang(freq_hz, cutoff_hz):
    freq = freq_hz
    cutoff = cutoff_hz
    osc.reset()
    env.start()

  sample:
    osc.freq = freq
    lpf.cutoff = cutoff
    env.decay_s = decay_s

    level = env()

    sig = 0.0
    if level > 0.00001:
      sig = lpf(osc()) * level * amp

    out1 = sig

params:
  auto_play = true
  freq_min = 110.0 {20.0, 4000.0}
  freq_max = 880.0 {20.0, 4000.0}
  cutoff_min = 300.0 {20.0, 20000.0}
  cutoff_max = 6000.0 {20.0, 20000.0}
  decay_s = 0.35 {0.01, 4.0}
  amp = 1.0 {0.0, 1.0}
  bpm = 126.0 {45.0, 220.0, unit = "BPM"}
  level = 1.0 {0.0, 1.0}

init:
  voices: Voice[NumVoices] = Voice()
  next_voice = 0
  rng = std::random::Rng()
  voice_pan: f32[NumVoices]
  clock = 0
  pending_bang = false

event bang():
  pending_bang = true

sample:
  period = max(i32(SR * 15.0 / bpm), 1)
  if auto_play && clock == 0:
    pending_bang = true
  clock = (clock + 1) % period

  if pending_bang:
    lo_freq = min(freq_min, freq_max)
    hi_freq = max(freq_min, freq_max)
    lo_cutoff = min(cutoff_min, cutoff_max)
    hi_cutoff = max(cutoff_min, cutoff_max)
    voices[next_voice].decay_s = decay_s
    voices[next_voice].amp = amp
    voices[next_voice].bang(
      freq_hz = rng.range(lo_freq, hi_freq),
      cutoff_hz = rng.range(lo_cutoff, hi_cutoff)
    )
    voice_pan[next_voice] = rng.range(-0.9, 0.9)
    next_voice = (next_voice + 1) % NumVoices
    pending_bang = false

  mix_l = 0.0
  mix_r = 0.0
  for i in 0..NumVoices:
    voice = voices[i]()
    gain_l, gain_r = std::levels::pan_3db(voice_pan[i])
    mix_l = mix_l + voice * gain_l
    mix_r = mix_r + voice * gain_r
  out1 = tanh(mix_l * level)
  out2 = tanh(mix_r * level)

    cutoff = 1200.0

    osc.freq = freq

    env.decay_s = decay_s

params:
  auto_play = true
  freq_min = 110.0 {20.0, 4000.0}
  freq_max = 880.0 {20.0, 4000.0}
  cutoff_min = 300.0 {20.0, 20000.0}

  decay_s = 0.35 {0.01, 4.0}
  amp = 1.0 {0.0, 1.0}
  bpm = 126.0 {45.0, 220.0, unit = "BPM"}
  level = 1.0 {0.0, 1.0}

init:
  voices: Voice[NumVoices] = Voice()
  next_voice = 0
  rng = std::random::Rng()
  voice_pan: f32[NumVoices]
  voice_gain_l: f32[NumVoices]
  voice_gain_r: f32[NumVoices]
  for i in 0..NumVoices:
    initial_l, initial_r = std::levels::pan_3db(voice_pan[i])
    voice_gain_l[i] = initial_l
    voice_gain_r[i] = initial_r
  clock = 0
  pending_bang = false

event bang():
  pending_bang = true

sample:
  period = max(i32(SR * 15.0 / bpm), 1)
  if auto_play && clock == 0:
    pending_bang = true
  clock = (clock + 1) % period

  if pending_bang:
    lo_freq = min(freq_min, freq_max)
    hi_freq = max(freq_min, freq_max)
    lo_cutoff = min(cutoff_min, cutoff_max)
    hi_cutoff = max(cutoff_min, cutoff_max)
    voices[next_voice].decay_s = decay_s
    voices[next_voice].amp = amp
    voices[next_voice].bang(
      freq_hz = rng.range(lo_freq, hi_freq),
      cutoff_hz = rng.range(lo_cutoff, hi_cutoff)
    )
    voice_pan[next_voice] = rng.range(-0.9, 0.9)
    next_l, next_r = std::levels::pan_3db(voice_pan[next_voice])
    voice_gain_l[next_voice] = next_l
    voice_gain_r[next_voice] = next_r
    next_voice = (next_voice + 1) % NumVoices
    pending_bang = false

  mix_l = 0.0
  mix_r = 0.0
  for i in 0..NumVoices:
    voice = voices[i]()
    gain_l = voice_gain_l[i]
    gain_r = voice_gain_r[i]
    mix_l = mix_l + voice * gain_l
    mix_r = mix_r + voice * gain_r
  out1 = tanh(mix_l * level)
  out2 = tanh(mix_r * level)

raw_audio_method: Three alternating direct/helper process pairs on CPU 2; each process has seven rotating binding-mode rounds of one million calls. Every mode checked bitwise against sequential scalar reference. Median of process medians. GCC O3 with contraction disabled; Onda object strict math.
reproduction: Restore diagnostic_sources under a local scratch directory. Use scripts/bench/run.py --source for the four probes, --backend both --ir --assembly --repetitions 7 --round-ms 75 --warmup-blocks 8192 --validation-blocks 256 --cpu 2 --memory-mib 4096 --timeout-seconds 120. Repeat only pan probes in reversed order. Compile raw_audio_harness against each emitted audio object with the retained command, adjusting artifact paths, then run three alternating pairs.

llvm.topic: LLVM vector math phase ordering and architecture

settings.timing_inputs: 128 equally spaced f32 values from -6 to 6
settings.validation_inputs: 131072 equally spaced f32 values from -100 to 100
settings.fp: no fast math or contraction; x86 FTZ/DAZ
settings.repetitions: three process pairs, reversed order for pair1
settings.application_backend: LLVM21.1.2 llc -mcpu=native; same optimized baseline IR

llvm.interpretation: Diagnostic only; dedicated exp2 helper built with systemClang23.1.3 from pinned SLEEF3.9, not pinned productionClang21.1.8. No production files changed. Generic vectorpow is slower and is rejected. No f64/AArch64/edge-case acceptance claimed.
llvm.transformation: Specialized: rename only two calls and the declaration llvm.exp2.v8f32 to Sleef_exp2f8_u10avx2; retain every scalar tail call and every other application instruction; compile LLVM21 llc -mcpu=native and link scratch strict SLEEF exp2 helper. Genericpow: replace two vector exp2 calls by fastcc bundled Sleef_powf8_u10avx2 with all base lanes=2.0, then internalize/globaldce/strip and LLVM21 llc; no applicationO3 rerun.

wasm_parameter_simd.explanation: Interface controls use PlaceBase::Param serialized as param; function formals use parameter. A scratch copy of the backend admits param in its invariant-load whitelist; production is unchanged.
wasm_parameter_simd.method: Three alternating pairs; seven 75ms rounds each; same MIR and Node/V8. Median of process medians. Original harness with only backend import changed for candidate. Memory/time cgroup limits retained.
wasm_parameter_simd.reproduction: Copy packages/onda_binaryen_web/src to scratch, retain resolution to its installed node_modules, and replace only the invariant load whitelist as recorded. Copy scripts/bench/wasm.mjs, resolve its wasm-memory.mjs import to the original helper, and its compiler import to the scratch index.js. Run the same emitted audio-direct.mir.msgpack via both workers with the probes config and CPU affinity 3. Retain original cgroup/heap limits; alternate before/after three times.
